text.1: It is dark in the cave.
text.2: It is dark in the cave. Pretty crystals glow on the walls.
text.3: You step into the Crystal Caverns. It is dark, but glowing crystals light up the walls in pink and blue.
text.4: You step into the Crystal Caverns, where the air is cool and still. Glowing crystals light the walls in soft pink and blue, and every sound echoes back.

feedback.3: The cave hums your tune back to you!

text.2: The crystal glows like a lamp. Now you can see the path.
text.3: The crystal glows brighter in your hand, like a little lamp. Now you can see the path ahead.
text.4: The crystal glows brighter in your hand, like a tiny lantern. Its light shows you a path winding deeper into the mountain.

feedback.3: Ouch! You bump your knee, but it is only a small bump.

text.2: A tiny bat hears your song. It flies down to say hi.
text.3: Your song echoes through the cave, and a tiny bat flutters down to say hello. It likes your tune.
text.4: Your song echoes through the cave until a tiny bat flutters down from the ceiling. It tilts its head, as if it wants to hear the tune again.

feedback.3: The bat spins in the air and dances!

text.1: A big gem giant blocks the way.
text.2: A big gem giant sits in the path. It is a Crystal Golem! It looks shy.
text.3: A big giant made of gems sits in the path. It is a Crystal Golem, and it looks shy. It hides its face behind its hands.
text.4: In the middle of the tunnel sits a giant made of sparkling gems. It is a Crystal Golem, and it looks very shy, hiding its face behind two huge stone hands.

feedback.3: The Golem peeks out and gives you a big smile!
The Golem waves a shy little wave.

text.1: What was the giant made of?
text.2: What was the giant made of?
text.3: What was the giant in the cave made of?
text.4: What was the giant in the cave made of?

feedback.3: Not quite. Think about the story.
Not quite. Think about the story.

text.1: You rest on a soft rock.
text.2: Your friend helps you rest on a soft rock. Now you feel better!
text.3: Your travel friend helps you to a soft, glowing rock. You rest for a while, and soon you feel strong again.
text.4: Your travel friend helps you to a smooth, glowing rock where you can sit. You rest and nibble a snack, and soon you feel strong again.

text.2: You are through the caverns! Dragon's Keep is next.
text.3: You are through the Crystal Caverns! The tunnel opens up, and you can see a big stone castle far away. It is Dragon's Keep.
text.4: You are through the Crystal Caverns! The tunnel opens to warm daylight, and far across the valley you see a big stone castle with a red flag. It is Dragon's Keep.
